(2) The small dog continues its high-energy play, shaking the mat vigorously while the man remains motionless on the sofa. The background setting is a typical modern apartment with curtains and minimalist furniture. The camera remains static throughout the sequence, providing a wide-angle view of the interior space. (3) The man eventually wakes up, sitting up slightly to look at the dog's activities. He reaches down with his hand to pat the dog and adjusts the mat it was playing with. His facial expression is groggy, indicating he was just woken up by the noise or movement. (4) After the brief interaction, the man lies back down on the sofa to continue his sleep. The dog stays on its mat, though it continues to move slightly. The scene settles back into a quiet state, with the monochrome lighting emphasizing the late-night domestic atmosphere.
